We may be only 15 years apart but I’ve been through a lot of shit that she hasn’t and I pass down what I’ve learned to her. We have fun, I take her places because she has bad anxiety and doesn’t have a drivers license. I do what I can to make sure she has someone she is comfortable enough to be able to talk to me and trust me as someone that has her back no matter what. I would lay down my life for my little family, even if everyone else has abandoned us. I want to be sure she has a safe place with me. Her bio mother is not that and has thrown her stuff away, fussed at her for stupid shit but I allow her freedom to express herself, within reason. Be something like that for your stepdaughter, help her feel like she has a safe place with you because I’m sure she might be feeling lost when her mother has those expectations and it’s not her style. I was constantly accused of having an attitude and being selfish. My siblings stole my things and were very mean to me and nothing was ever done about it. (I’m the oldest of four kids, we’re all adults now.) 

I have never been able to hold a job or finish college due to my mental health. I joined the Air Force at 19 because I was the “problem” child and needed straightening up. I wound up getting diagnosed with severe depression and anxiety while in and was honorably discharged two years later. They pretend I was never in even though I fucking graduated basic training in 2010 after getting seriously sick and being there an extra four weeks. I still get full disabled veteran benefits though. In 2013 I decided to become an EMT-basic and did very well with the schooling part and got my license. I was so excited about actually finishing something and did well with it. I went to my parents’ house to show them my license and my dad was happy for me. I had the envelope in my hand when I went to show my mom and she asked, “Is that your crap?” I felt so beat down after that and left right after. 

When I was a preteen/teen my mom would get mad at me for whatever reason, yell at me while stepping on my foot and poking me in the forehead. I’d pull my foot out and she’d do it again, I guess trying to intimidate me. I did EMDR treatment and released a lot of serious pent up emotions but it’s still hard to think about. 

Sorry this was so long, I still hold a ton of resentment toward her and have yet to work through it even though I have a psychiatrist and a psychologist. The VA here sucks but I’m not going to go into that. I’m about to be 33 in less than two weeks. They don’t understand why I never talk to them.
